comments.value: It's a bit better right now, but I still believe it should be changed.

details:
At this moment, on the pages of Avatars and Worlds, the compatibility with platforms is marked as a **single feature icon** with texts: ‘Any Platform’, ‘Only PC’, ‘Only Mobile’ This looks fine in English, but there are **two problems**:

**First, small text area to fit MUCH more text**. In some languages, the text is longer, and it does not fit in. In Russian, the word ‘платформа’ for platform does not fit horizontally at all and gets split. But actually, we need to put longer texts: ‘Для любой платформы’, ‘Только для ПК платформы’, ‘Только для мобильной платформы’. Okay, we can reduce it by dropping the word ‘платформа’, getting ‘Для любой’, ‘Только для ПК’, ‘Только для мобильной’ which is much worse and only the PC one is correct. In Russian, we can’t use ‘mobile’ by itself, it must be ‘something mobile’. So, we can reduce the words ‘only’ and ‘for’, to get ‘Любая платформа’, ‘ПК платформа’, ‘Мобильная платформа’, which is better, but still has issues: the words ‘платформа’ and ‘мобильная’ both have 9 letters and do not fit horizontally, and nobody calls PC a platform in Russian, this can be fixed by using ‘Только для ПК’, but it becomes **an inconsistent mess**. We can simply just put ‘Любая’, ‘Только ПК’, ‘Только мобильная’, but this will leave **a lot of confusion** for the end user before reading the tooltip.

It is related to

- https://feedback.vrchat.com/localization/p/area-of-text-of-some-buttons-need-to-be-enlarged

- https://feedback.vrchat.com/localization/p/condensed-fonts-for-languages-where-phrases-longer-than-average

but not limited, as it is about **language forms** and consistency too.

**Second, different platforms in future**. I suspect there will be more platforms (such as iOS) which are likely to have separate asset bundles due to different architecture. So, this feature icon is likely to be more complicated than now. How are we going to describe assets that are compatible with PC, Mobile, but not the new platform? Or compatible with PC and the new platform, but not mobile?

My **proposal** here is to **split this feature badge**. Something like... Each platform has **its own icon** on **each asset** with a corresponding label, like both ‘Available on PC’ and ‘Not Available on Mobile’ with maybe different visualization.

Or this can be something like inline list, ‘This avatar/world is available on PC, Mobile, Whatever platforms’, or even better list of separate elements, like: ‘This avatar/world is available on platforms:’ <new line> then list of read-only toggles or for each platform, or visual icons. Not necessarily separate subcategory on the page, it can be **joined rectangle** like avatar visibility one on QM.

This will help to write simple and uniform labels in every language omitting language forms with words like ‘any’, ‘only’, fixing other inconsistencies, providing and binding context to each other being neighboring icons, and even the word ‘platform’ can be moved to the tooltips. And this is well-scalable for more platforms in future.

This will **not** solve issues with text scaling and splitting but helps a lot in **writing simple and easy to read and understand platform labels**.
title: Rework required for content platform compatibility icons
